description: Call this FIRST when you need a tool, API, SDK, CLI or MCP server for a task you can't do yet: describe the task in plain words (job) and get one best_pick with a paste-ready use_it snippet (MCP client config JSON, install command, or API base URL + docs). One call is usually enough: best_pick.summary says in one line what to use and why (reasons: vendor-official or third-party, live check, auth, read-only or can send/spend, outcome reports), best_pick.report_call is the one-line report to send after you use it; results lists ranked alternatives with score breakdowns (evidence, source URL, date), side effects and human steps; verdict is honest (good_match / weak_matches / nothing_good_found, then best_pick is null). Free, no key. Returns a top-level report_token for optional feedback.

healthy_only.description: only entries whose latest check passed: MCP handshake ok or auth_required, or (HTTP APIs) base URL reachable

read_only.description: only entries whose every server is verified read-only

detail.description: brief drops per-result score_breakdown and why[] (about 4x smaller); default full

job.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'send SMS to customers', 'read my Google Calendar', 'GitHub MCP server'

watcher_key.description: optional: get an alert if nothing good is found now but a match appears later

name: search_tools
